intake_statement: Prove that critical bond percolation on Z^2 at p = 1/2 is conformally invariant in the scaling limit (Cardy's formula and convergence of interfaces to SLE(6)), as is known on the triangular lattice by Smirnov.
intake_source: probability_1000_intake_claude_20260907/problems.jsonl:17, source_id garban_steif_noise_2012, Chapter II Section 4; line independently verified. In arXiv:1102.5761v3 the explicit open sentence appears on PDF page 25, so the intake's p.26 locator is imprecise.
working_quantifiers: For bounded Jordan domains with four distinct ordered boundary marks and canonical square-lattice approximations, seek Cardy's scaling limit for open crossing probabilities. Separately, for a domain with Dobrushin boundary conditions, seek exploration-path convergence in the curve topology to chordal SLE(6). Boundary and approximation conventions require source-specific verification.

primary_literature.scope: Garban-Steif Chapter II Section 4 states square-lattice conformal invariance was open when written; this is historical status only.
Tsai-Yam-Zhou v5 claims interface convergence; author comment calls it preliminary and says critical comments require revision.
Zhou v6 Theorem 2 claims interface convergence under Condition C, and Corollary 1.1 claims a Cardy crossing limit under Condition C. Their proofs have not been independently audited here.
Zhang's main theorem is site percolation on a sheared square lattice; its abstract about Cardy's formula must not be silently applied to C0017 bond percolation.

owner_prior_work_scope: C0017-A001 in intake attempts.jsonl:17 stopped at a missing square-bond discrete-analytic observable relation; no C0017 entry found in named H/I attempt directories, and the named Big Open percolation project targets nonamenable graphs. This is a bounded search.
reason_for_unknown: Later primary preprints claim proofs, but their load-bearing mathematical steps and current acceptance have not been independently checked.
